subject: Request: Activation Waiver for Deferred Discount — ACME Health
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmehealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com; marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com; priya.shah@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Final terms — activation timing and discount

Laura / Marissa —

Thanks again for the time this week. We (ACME Health) are comfortable with the 30% introductory discount you proposed for the first 12 months, provided the discount only applies once our production onboarding completes (we expect go-live in Q1). We are requesting two things before we sign:

- Activation waiver: allow discount to backdate to the date we first move traffic into production (we ask for retroactive activation for up to 60 days).
- Billing flexibility: one-month hold on invoicing during cutover if there are unforeseen integration issues.

We understand this is nonstandard. We wanted to surface it early to get internal approval before we push the DocuSign. Our procurement lead is cc'd.

Sanjay Rao
VP, Platform Engineering
ACME Health

Attachments: acme_requirements_v2.pdf (referenced)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com; ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Final terms — activation timing and discount

Marissa / Ben — please see ACME's ask below. Quick summary for exec review:

- Deal: 12-month intro discount 30% on hosted inference (text gen + embeddings), committed ARR = $1.2M.
- Customer asks that discount activation be retroactive to production traffic for up to 60 days and that we allow a one-month hold on invoicing during cutover.
- Risk: potential revenue shortfall and precedent for retro credits if we accept.

Attached is a short memo (activation-waiver-deal-memo.pdf) with margin impact and two mitigation options. Ask: can we get VP/CFO nod for a one-time activation-waiver for this strategic health prospect? I recommend Option B (conditional retro up to 30 days + requirement to sign the full 12-month commitment on DocuSign before credit applies).

Notes: HubSpot deal DW-ACME-2026-1120; competitive pressure from vendor X is real. Timelines: ACME wants DocuSign by next Wednesday.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: activation-waiver-deal-memo.pdf, acme_mop_summary.xlsx
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com; laura_bennett@redwood.com; ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Final terms — activation timing and discount

Markus — looping you in for finance signoff. Key numbers for quick read:

- ARR committed: $1,200,000 (12 months)
- Proposed discount: 30% first 12 months -> gross impact ~ $360k; expected net given usual COGS/kmg: $240k hit in first year (approx).
- Proposed conditional option (recommended): apply discount retro to production for up to 30 days only if: (1) ACME signs binding 12-month contract on DocuSign before go-live, (2) they hit onboarding milestones in our MOP.
- If we grant 60-day retro, expected incremental credit liability increases materially and sets precedent for managed-health vertical.

I need VP/CFO explicit authorization to accept Option B or any deviation. If we can do Option B with the 30-day cap and the invoice hold limited to 1x month (non-crediting), I think we protect revenue while closing the deal.

Asks for you, Markus:
1) Approve Option B (conditional 30-day retro credit) OR
2) If not, please provide exact language we should use in the DocuSign amendment to limit exposure.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Quoted message:
> From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
> Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
> Subject: Fwd: Final terms — activation timing and discount
> > (original message from ACME)
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com; marissa_cole@redwood.com; ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Final terms — activation timing and discount

Laura / Marissa — after reviewing the memo and P&L impact, finance is willing to approve a controlled, one-time activation waiver on the following conditions: 

- Approval: VP/CFO signoff granted for a one-time retroactive discount backdating up to 30 days only (not 60).
- Preconditions: ACME must sign the full 12-month commitment in DocuSign before we begin any production traffic.
- Auditability: Onboarding milestones must be logged in our MOP and a short onboarding acceptance form must be completed by ACME's platform lead (Priya Shah) to trigger the retro.
- Invoice hold: We will allow one billing cycle deferral during cutover but will not issue credits beyond the 30-day cap; any disputed usage will be handled as a separate make-good request with revenue ops approval.

Markus Klein
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference

--
Next steps: Laura, send the DocuSign amendment with the exact conditional language Markus outlined and copy financeops@redwood.com. I'll close once the signed DocuSign and onboarding acceptance are in HubSpot.
